entity.summary: Protocol-level decentralized exchange on Verus using reserve-backed basket currencies as automated market makers for on-chain and cross-chain asset conversions.
entity.notes: Current first-party documentation describes Verus basket currencies as AMMs that support reserve-to-reserve conversions and the current Verus site identifies protocol-level DeFi conversion activity. Independent current metrics classify Verus Market as an AMM DEX with non-zero volume, fees, revenue, and TVL. The Verus-Ethereum Bridge is not modeled as a separate exchange entity here.

evidence.title: Verus basket currencies and AMM conversions
evidence.notes: First-party documentation states that Verus basket currencies function as AMMs with reserves and permit reserve-to-reserve conversions, establishing the protocol-level decentralized exchange mechanism.

evidence.title: Verus Market current DEX metrics
evidence.notes: Independent current metrics classify Verus Market as an AMM DEX on Verus and report non-zero DEX volume, fees, revenue, and TVL, supporting active classification.
